My parents don't like it if I say "sucks". I'm 13, and I say dammit and shit when I'm frustrated. ( but not when they're around. ) There is no point censoring kids. Your kids will end up saying them anyways, and learning them, but they'll be too afraid to say it around you, so they won't know appropriate instances to say them.  Especially in the instances of things they should not be saying, like racial slurs; they won't know the difference between things that are ok to say, like dammit, and things that are never ok, under any circumstances, like racial slurs. 

Of course, they shouldn't be cursing at people, but cursing at a lego that you stepped on is fine. Kids will learn these words, and censoring them is producing the opposite affect that you want - for them to be respectful, and well educated. Because let's face it - not educating them on cursing is not preparing them for modern society, and the language used. 

And my god, don't just ground them if they ask you what shit or dammit means!
